baseline_models.reading: By the swift-running ones, audibly panting. The focus presents bodily movement together with its breath-sound; horses are a natural realization of the supplied images.

focus_anchor.role: The oath construction introduces running agents, while the accusative verbal noun specifies the accompanying sound or manner.

activation_trace.role: Running and hastening, explicitly including a horse's running, supply the movement image.
The scope specifically includes horses' audible breathing or mouth-sound while running; that pairing selects a pertinent part of the broader animal-cry branch.

baseline_models.mechanism: The running participle and manner noun mutually constrain one another: movement gives the sound an exertional setting, and the sound makes the movement bodily and audible. The initial waw and genitive form carry the oath reading.
baseline_models.reader_inference: The packet supplies the running-horse and running-breath combination, so no additional causal assumption is needed for that image. Supplying an explicit noun such as horses is an identification by the reader; the focus itself leaves the agents unnamed.
baseline_models.containment: Preserve this ordinary reading. The focus alone does not identify a raid, riders, allegiance, destination, or moral motive, and the feminine plural does not by itself establish female horses.

baseline_models.reading: A coexisting focus-only reading takes the manner noun as running with extended forelegs: the verse specifies the runners' gait rather than principally their breath-sound.

focus_anchor.role: The accusative manner expression can further characterize the movement already named by the preceding participle.

activation_trace.role: The running scope establishes the locomotion that the second word can elaborate.
This distinct scope names horse or camel movement with stretched forelegs, as well as light running; it supports a gait reading without importing the separate cry branch.

baseline_models.mechanism: A motion sense of the manner noun intensifies the first word through a more specific bodily action, producing a kinetic rather than primarily acoustic picture.
baseline_models.reader_inference: No additional event or cause is needed. Choosing this supplied movement sense over the breath-sound sense is interpretive; the inventory supplies both and does not rank them.
baseline_models.containment: Retain as a lexical alternative, not as proof that panting is absent. Its horse-or-camel scope also prevents the focus alone from settling animal identity.

context_deltas.reading: The panting run now opens a connected scene of vigorous action and struck fire. Its sound is placed beside the material contact and flash of ignition.

focus_anchor.role: The initial running and breathing become the first sensory component of the linked description.

activation_trace.role: Running supplies the physical activity subsequently associated with striking fire.
Audible running-breath remains the acoustic side of the developing scene.
The fire emerging from a striker or being kindled supplies ignition, rather than the unrelated covering or illness scopes.
Striking fire from wood, stone, or an implement makes physical contact part of the image.

structural_cues.role: The definite feminine plural and following manner noun establish the opening pattern.
Fa and the matching participle-plus-manner construction connect ignition to the running description.

context_deltas.mechanism: Syntactic parallelism and fa make the second image qualify how the opening run is imagined: audible bodily effort belongs to an action sequence that also produces fire through striking.

changed_reading.before: Running and audible breathing form a self-contained bodily image.
changed_reading.after: The same opening is heard as the start of an action sequence combining breath, contact, and ignition.

context_deltas.reader_inference: Common agents are a natural reading of the matching constructions, though successive related groups remain possible. Connecting the strike specifically to hooves hitting stones is a further physical reconstruction, not an explicit statement of either ayah.
context_deltas.containment: The link supports a more concrete, forceful scene without specifying horseshoes, terrain, or a mechanically exact order of impacts. Keep the breath sense intact.

context_deltas.reading: The runners become the initiating agents of a dawn incursion that stirs dust and reaches the middle of an assembled body. Their speed has a collective destination and an effect on their surroundings.

focus_anchor.role: The opening agents and their bodily effort are carried forward into the later feminine plural actions.

activation_trace.role: Running is now situated within a directed incursion rather than left without a destination.
The scope explicitly includes a morning raid and going out with horses, supporting the dawn-incursion setting of the phrase.
Stirring dust or earth from its settled state gives the runners' movement an outward material effect.
Raised dust identifies what the motion visibly disturbs.
Entering the middle of a group supplies penetration into an interior, not merely speed across open space.
An assembled body, including the possible army scope, supplies the collective encountered by the runners.

structural_cues.role: The feminine plural running agents open the sequence.
The parallel feminine plural phrase gives the action its incursion setting and morning time.
Fa and the feminine plural verb continue the agents through an effect on the ground.
The matching verbal construction brings the movement into the midst of a collective.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following the ayat in order converts an initially unlocated manner of movement into a connected incursion: its time, disturbance, and destination retrospectively specify the opening run.

changed_reading.before: The focus supplies moving bodies and a manner of running, with no stated destination.
changed_reading.after: The running initiates a dawn approach or charge that raises dust and enters an assembled body.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The shared-agent reading follows the repeated feminine forms. The ordinary construction of مُغِيرَٰتِ and the supplied morning-raid scope support incursion, although the غ ي ر inventory itself supplies no explicit raid branch. An enemy army, a particular campaign, and the precise referent of بِهِۦ are not settled.
context_deltas.containment: Do not infer that every raid is unjust or that the group is necessarily hostile. The chain connects actions without requiring every fa to encode a separately timed mechanical step.

context_deltas.reading: The opening's strenuous movement is an oath image brought to bear on human ingratitude toward the Lord. Its rhetorical purpose is now a claim about a human relationship, rather than an uncompleted appeal to a vivid scene.

focus_anchor.role: The oath that begins with the runners receives an emphatic answering assertion in 100:6.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and authority identify the relation within which the human fault is asserted.
Ingratitude for favors and withheld support give the oath's answering proposition its relational content.

structural_cues.role: The opening oath creates an expectation of an assertion.
Inna and the emphatic lam provide the natural oath-answer, explicitly centering the human and his Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The oath-answer construction changes the function of the focus: its kinetic vividness introduces and presses an emphatic judgment about human conduct.

changed_reading.before: The running image is sworn by, but the focus alone leaves the assertion it supports unspecified.
changed_reading.after: The image belongs to an oath affirming human ingratitude toward the Lord.

context_deltas.reader_inference: No further causal assumption is needed for the oath-answer relation. Whether the runners contrast with the human, resemble the human's conduct, or supply another kind of evidential pressure remains an interpretive question.
context_deltas.containment: This grammatical connection does not itself make the runners grateful, ungrateful, righteous, or culpable. Keep the directional analogies separately qualified.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: Alongside the breath reading, the focus's manner word can acquire a secondary fire-touched surface image: running and panting are heard against the possibility of scorching at the point of striking.

focus_anchor.role: The same focus root supplies both the ordinary breath-sound branch and a distinct scorching branch activated by the next ayah.

activation_trace.role: Running-breath remains the primary bodily reading with which the thermal image coexists.
Scorching is scoped to upper wood, fire-striker stones, and things touched by fire; the striker-stone overlap makes this more specific than a general association with heat.
Emerging or kindled fire activates the thermal field immediately after the focus.
Striking fire from stone or wood supplies a material interface matching the focus's otherwise distant scorching scope.

structural_cues.role: The focus manner noun is the location of the secondary activation.
Immediate syntactic adjacency makes actual fire and striking the trigger.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The next ayah selects a material overlap within a second supplied branch of the focus root. This lets the panting run carry a thermal undertone without replacing its ordinary bodily sense.

changed_reading.before: The manner word evokes breath-sound or gait.
changed_reading.after: The manner word can additionally resonate with fire touching a struck surface.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The packet supplies the paired material scopes; treating their proximity as an intentional resonance is the reader's inference. It does not establish that the focus token directly denotes scorching, or that any surface actually becomes charred.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from animal breath to combustion through a specific lexical scope. Present it as a secondary resonance, never as a claim that the animals are burning or that the focus should simply be translated as fire.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: The panting runners can be viewed as creatures spending bodily effort in service, sharpening human ingratitude by contrast with a visible response to a directing or sustaining relation.

focus_anchor.role: Running with audible breath makes the expenditure of bodily effort available for a comparison about response and return.

activation_trace.role: The horse-running scope permits, without proving, an animal engaged in a human-directed action.
The sound of running-breath makes exertion perceptible rather than leaving service an abstract attribution.
The scope includes both divine lordship and the owner or master of an animal, supplying a precise relational bridge.
Nurture and ongoing care make the relation potentially one of received support and response.
Forgetting benefits and withholding support supply the contrasting failure of return.

structural_cues.role: The visible action and audible exertion form one side of the proposed comparison.
The shared arrival within a collective gives the run a possible setting of directed service.
The answering assertion makes failed human reciprocity the other side.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The owner-and-animal scope of lordship permits an analogy between strenuous creaturely action and the response owed within a sustaining relation. The oath-answer supplies the contrast with human ingratitude.

changed_reading.before: Panting specifies how the runners move.
changed_reading.after: Panting can also make their expenditure of effort salient as a foil to withheld human response.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: A directing owner or rider and service to that person are inferred, not named. Voluntary animal gratitude is not supplied at all. The same incursion can instead be read as an analogue of human acquisitive drive, so the direction of comparison remains live.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The surprising move is from bodily performance to reciprocity through the dual scope of lordship. Qualify it as a possible contrast; do not attribute conscious moral virtue to the animals or transfer divine status to a human owner.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: A competing reading hears the rush as a bodily analogue of human intensity toward a coveted good. In that frame, running can take on an undertone of pressing beyond a proper limit.

focus_anchor.role: The running root also contains a specifically qualified overstepping branch, which can become relevant when the incursion is placed beside human attachment and ingratitude.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary running image supplies the bodily force that the analogy preserves.
Overstepping into injustice includes raiding only when it exceeds right; this conditional scope provides the possible moral overtone, not an automatic verdict on raids.
The self-serving and withholding aspects of ingratitude allow a comparison with directed human appetite.
Clinging affection and preference supply the actual attachment being described.
Desired or beneficial good supplies the object of attachment without assuming that the inventory specifies booty or money.
Intensity and exertion support the immediate description of the human's attachment.
The distinct charging-and-running scope returns human intensity to the bodily action of the focus.

structural_cues.role: The forceful bodily action is the source image.
The incursion setting makes the possible charge-and-overstepping association specific.
The human's conduct, rather than the animals' moral status, is the expressed subject of criticism.
The emphatic assertion of strong attachment supplies the psychological counterpart.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The charging scope of ش د د connects later human intensity to the initial run; the qualified aggression scope of ع د و then permits, but does not compel, a moralized reading of forward pressure.

changed_reading.before: The runners exhibit physical speed and effort without a moral designation.
changed_reading.after: Their rush can image the force of human attachment, with a possible warning about desire that crosses a limit.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The packet supplies running, charge, intense attachment, and qualified overstepping. Treating the raid as acquisitive or unjust is a reader-supplied direction of comparison. No stated object identifies spoils, and loving what is good is not intrinsically condemned by the root's scope.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain analogy from motion to appetite, supported by two scoped lexical bridges. Keep it distinct from the service-and-reciprocity contrast, and do not present it as proof that the oath condemns the runners or that every incursion is wrongdoing.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: The opening's running and panting can function as a bodily model of disclosure: outward performance makes inward exertion perceptible, anticipating testimony and the exposure of what chests contain.

focus_anchor.role: Observable running and audible breath provide an external sign of an internal bodily condition.

activation_trace.role: The scoped sound of horses' breathing while running supplies something internal becoming audible.
The witnessing-sign scope explicitly includes a horse's visible run as evidence of a state or quality, giving an unusually precise return to the focus scene.
Testifying from knowledge supplies the evidential function with which bodily manifestation is compared.
The anatomical chest gives the later inner-content statement a bodily location comparable to the focus's breathing.
Bringing a result into clarity, explicitly including disclosure of what is in chests, supplies the later revealing action.
Knowledge of inward reality rather than outward appearance completes the comparison between perceptible signs and inner knowledge.

structural_cues.role: The opening renders movement and breath outwardly perceptible.
Witness language introduces explicit attestation of the preceding human condition.
The construction singles out inner contents for disclosure.
The final emphasis places those persons under their Lord's intimate knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The specific witnessing-run branch links the focus's sensory display to attestation. The later chest and inward-knowledge language permits a further analogy between breath manifesting bodily exertion and disclosure manifesting concealed human reality.

changed_reading.before: Panting gives the run an audible bodily texture.
changed_reading.after: That sound can also serve as an example of a condition revealing itself outwardly, within a passage concerned with testimony and exposed interiors.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The packet supplies the witnessing-run image and explicit disclosure language. The physiological link from breathing to the chest, and the analogy from exertion to moral interiority, are reader-supplied. The pronoun in 100:7 may be taken with the human or the Lord; neither resolution makes the runners its grammatical subject.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The surprising anchor is the inventory's explicit horse-run witness example. Treat the reading as a model of manifestation, not as proof that panting establishes ingratitude, that animals testify verbally, or that the Lord first acquires knowledge on the stated day.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: The opening run can become the first side of a reversal in agency: its agents disturb the ground, whereas the later human scene concerns buried contents subjected to an upheaval they do not direct.

focus_anchor.role: The active running agents initiate the outward motion that 100:4 carries into disturbed earth.

activation_trace.role: Running supplies the initial agency and movement.
The scope of moving dust or earth from a settled state furnishes the first material disturbance.
Raised dust keeps the comparison tied to the actual material effect of the opening sequence.
Overturning earth and extracting buried contents intensify surface disturbance into exposure of what lies underneath.
Graves as the resting places of the dead specify the later ground and its contents.

structural_cues.role: Active participles establish bodies acting through forceful movement.
An active feminine plural verb carries their agency into dust-raising.

structural_cues.quote_ar: أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
structural_cues.role: The question turns attention toward a future condition, with buried contents undergoing a passive upheaval.
A second passive extends the later condition of being subjected to disclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: Shared disturbed earth links the scenes materially, while the contrast between active movers and passive exposed contents changes how the opening force is valued: capacity to act is placed beside eventual subjection to an action beyond one's control.

changed_reading.before: The runners appear as agents whose motion changes their surroundings.
changed_reading.after: Their agency can be read against a later reversal in which human hidden contents are themselves disturbed and brought out.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The packet supplies both disturbances and their grammatical voices. Reading them as a deliberate reversal is the reader's inference. It does not require identifying the animals with the dead, and the passive verbs do not themselves name their agent.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a surprising scale change from running over earth to upheaval of buried interiors, anchored by the intervening dust scene. Do not claim the charge causes the graves to open, that the battlefield is a cemetery, or that the same beings act in both scenes.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: An agrarian analogy can place the panting run under a question of effort and yield: great motion stirs earth, while the human fault can be pictured as ground that gives no return to nurture, and the ending draws out what is inside.

focus_anchor.role: The focus makes energetic bodily expenditure vivid; the later dust effect lets that expenditure participate in a soil-and-yield comparison.

activation_trace.role: Running-breath renders effort audible, supplying the expenditure side of the proposed comparison.
Stirring earth connects the opening activity to an actual ground image before any agrarian analogy is introduced.
Nurture and ongoing improvement supply the received care against which return can be considered.
The ordinary human ingratitude branch remains the proposition being imaged.
Barren land that produces nothing supplies a concrete non-return image for that human ingratitude.
The explicitly scoped extraction of a kernel from husks allows disclosure to be pictured as drawing out an inner yield; the separate ore-extraction part is not needed.

structural_cues.role: Energetic movement and breath anchor the proposed question about expenditure.
The running sequence has already made disturbed ground a visible result.
Nurturing lordship and human non-return occur within one relation.
The ending specifies inner contents as what is drawn into disclosure, allowing the yield image to return to the human.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The actual dust scene provides the material bridge from the run to the barren-land scope of human ingratitude. Nurture and kernel extraction then make a comparison between expenditure, received care, and disclosed return available.

changed_reading.before: The opening's effort is judged by its vigor and its immediate physical effects.
changed_reading.after: That vivid effort can become one side of a question about what activity and nurture ultimately yield within the human.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The packet supplies dust-raising, barren ground, nurture, and kernel extraction as separately scoped elements. Joining them into an effort-and-yield analogy is the reader's construction. Neither the opening terrain's infertility nor the runners' failure to accomplish their purpose is stated.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it brings a charge into an agrarian moral comparison, but the dust effect prevents it from floating free of the focus. Keep it figurative: the horses are not said to plow, the human is not literally a field, and the ending does not promise a valuable kernel.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: The running display can acquire a tentative distinction between energetic flash and useful result: the later love-root's weak hoof-spark image lets the opening's force be reconsidered beside attachment to what is desired as good.

focus_anchor.role: The running bodies and their audible effort supply the expenditure whose accompanying sparks can be reconsidered for their value.

activation_trace.role: The running-horse scope gives a concrete possible source for the hoof sparks named in the later distant branch.
Audible running-breath preserves the focus on bodily expenditure.
Actual struck fire in the adjacent scene supplies the trigger for a later hoof-spark association.
The ordinary attachment sense remains the meaning of the later human claim.

The Arabic scope specifically includes faint sparks from stones or horses' hooves and fire of no use; this concrete overlap, rather than the branch's firefly image, returns attention to the opening run.
Desired beneficial good supplies the value term against which merely flashing, unusable fire can be compared.

structural_cues.role: The opening supplies movement and bodily effort.
Fire is linked to that opening action before the distant branch is activated.
Strong attachment and desired good give the later association a question of value, rather than leaving it a second fire description.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: A highly specific hoof-spark scope under the later love root crosses back to the running-and-striking scene. Its no-use qualification permits a comparison between energetic display and the benefit sought through intense attachment.

changed_reading.before: Running and struck fire principally display force and material contact.
changed_reading.after: Their display can also raise the possibility that intense expenditure produces a flash without a correspondingly useful return.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The packet supplies the hoof-spark and no-use image in a distinct branch; it does not equate حُبِّ with the expression نار الحباحب. Applying that image to the fire of 100:2, or interpreting attachment as misvaluation, is the reader's analogy. The fire could instead be useful, and the charge could achieve its purpose.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The surprising association is anchored by the exact horse-hoof scope and the intervening striking-fire ayah. Present it as a possible reflection on the value of effort, not a translation of love as sparks, a judgment that all desired good is worthless, or a claim that the runners act futilely.

summary.ordinary_reading: The focus swears by swift runners, naturally imagined as horses audibly panting. The following linked descriptions place their action beside struck fire, a dawn incursion, raised dust, and entry into an assembled body; the oath answers in an assertion of human ingratitude toward the Lord.
coexisting_readings: The focus also supports a distinct gait reading of ضَبْحًۭا as stretched-foreleg running; it need not be collapsed into the breath-sound sense.
The adjacent fire-striking phrase can activate a secondary scorching resonance within the focus's manner word.

An inferred service relation can make the runners' expenditure a contrast with human ingratitude; a competing charge-and-attachment analogy can instead make their forward force resemble human acquisitive intensity.
The witnessed-run scope, chest disclosure, and inward knowledge permit the opening's bodily display to model the manifestation of an otherwise inward condition.
Dust raised by active runners can be compared with the later passive upheaval of buried contents, placing physical agency beside eventual subjection to disclosure.
The barren-ground and kernel-extraction scopes allow a qualified effort-and-yield analogy to grow from the actual dust scene.
A distant but specifically hoof-related spark branch under the love root permits a separate, tentative comparison between energetic flash and useful result.
unresolved_limits: The packet records no source gaps, and its non-citable orientation contains no out-of-window ayat. An empty gap record does not make the inventories exhaustive of every constructional reading.

The focus does not name horses, camels, riders, an owner, a campaign, or the runners' sex. Common agents across the feminine forms are natural but not compulsory; the referents of بِهِۦ and the identity of the assembled body remain open.

The غ ي ر inventory supplies no explicit raid branch; the incursion reading rests on the supplied phrase and the ص ب ح morning-raid scope. The خ ي ر inventory does not explicitly identify wealth or booty, so a specifically material motive remains hypothetical.

The oath-answer establishes a connection to human ingratitude but does not decide whether the opening is an ethical contrast or a likeness. The aggression branch applies to a raid only when it exceeds right.
The witness pronoun in 100:7 permits a human or Lord referent; the exploratory bodily-sign reading does not resolve it or make the animals its grammatical subject.

All outliers are analogies or secondary lexical activations, not additional certain events or replacement translations. Distinct branch scopes and mapped root targets do not by themselves authorize a new derivation of an ayah's actual form.

variant.scope_ar: صوت الثعلب والهام والبوم والذئب والصدى وصوت أنفاس الخيل وأفواهها في العدو
variant.scope_en: fox, owl, wolf, echo cry, and the audible breathing or mouth-sound of horses while running

citation.role: Scorching is scoped to upper wood, fire-striker stones, and things touched by fire; the striker-stone overlap makes this more specific than a general association with heat.

variant.scope_ar: إحراق أعلى العود وحجارة القداحة وما مسته النار حتى يبدو مضبوحا
variant.scope_en: scorching the upper part of wood, fire-striker stones, or anything touched by fire so that it is charred

citation.role: Emerging or kindled fire activates the thermal field immediately after the focus.

variant.image_en: hidden fire coming out of the fire-stick
variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه وري الزند وورى الزند وخروج ناره، وإيراء الزند أو النار، وإيقاد النار الخامدة ورفعها، وما يثقب به النار.
variant.scope_en: This covers the fire-stick catching, hidden fire emerging, kindling or rekindling fire, and fuel used to make fire take.

citation.role: Striking fire from stone or wood supplies a material interface matching the focus's otherwise distant scorching scope.

variant.scope_ar: قدح النار والزند والحجر والحديدة التي تورى بها النار
variant.scope_en: Striking or kindling fire from a fire-stick, stone, or implement.

citation.role: The focus manner noun is the location of the secondary activation.
Immediate syntactic adjacency makes actual fire and striking the trigger.
The horse-running scope permits, without proving, an animal engaged in a human-directed action.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الجري والحضر وعدو الفرس والعدو على الأقدام
variant.scope_en: Includes running, hastening, a horse's running, and people running on foot.

citation.role: The sound of running-breath makes exertion perceptible rather than leaving service an abstract attribution.

variant.scope_ar: صوت الثعلب والهام والبوم والذئب والصدى وصوت أنفاس الخيل وأفواهها في العدو
variant.scope_en: fox, owl, wolf, echo cry, and the audible breathing or mouth-sound of horses while running

citation.role: The scope includes both divine lordship and the owner or master of an animal, supplying a precise relational bridge.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الرب بمعنى الله تعالى، ومالك الشيء، وسيده المطاع، وصاحبه، ورب الدار والدابة والملك
variant.scope_en: Includes rabb as God, an owner, an obeyed master, a possessor, and the lord of a house, animal, or king.

citation.role: Nurture and ongoing care make the relation potentially one of received support and response.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه رب الشيء إذا أصلحه وأتمه وقام عليه، ورب النعمة والصنيعة والضيعة والولد والصبي، والتربية حالا فحالا
variant.scope_en: Includes repairing, completing, administering, and nurturing a thing, favor, estate, child, or young person stage by stage.

citation.role: Forgetting benefits and withholding support supply the contrasting failure of return.

variant.scope_ar: الكنود وكند وامرأة كنود في كفر النعمة والمواصلة والمودة وعد المصائب ونسيان النعم والأثرة ومنع الرفد
variant.scope_en: Ingratitude for favor, companionship, and affection, including counting misfortunes, forgetting blessings, self-serving behavior, and withholding support.

citation.role: The visible action and audible exertion form one side of the proposed comparison.
The shared arrival within a collective gives the run a possible setting of directed service.
The answering assertion makes failed human reciprocity the other side.
The ordinary running image supplies the bodily force that the analogy preserves.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الجري والحضر وعدو الفرس والعدو على الأقدام
variant.scope_en: Includes running, hastening, a horse's running, and people running on foot.

citation.role: Overstepping into injustice includes raiding only when it exceeds right; this conditional scope provides the possible moral overtone, not an automatic verdict on raids.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه التعدي والاعتداء والعدوان وعدا على غيره والإغارة إذا كانت ظلما أو تجاوزا للحق
variant.scope_en: Includes transgression, aggression, injustice, attacking another, and raiding when framed as overstepping right.

citation.role: The self-serving and withholding aspects of ingratitude allow a comparison with directed human appetite.

variant.scope_ar: الكنود وكند وامرأة كنود في كفر النعمة والمواصلة والمودة وعد المصائب ونسيان النعم والأثرة ومنع الرفد
variant.scope_en: Ingratitude for favor, companionship, and affection, including counting misfortunes, forgetting blessings, self-serving behavior, and withholding support.

citation.role: Clinging affection and preference supply the actual attachment being described.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الحب والمحبة ونقيض البغض، والتحبيب، والمحبوب، والاستحباب بمعنى الإيثار، والمودة المتبادلة.
variant.scope_en: This branch covers love, affection, making beloved, being beloved, preference, and mutual affection.

citation.role: Desired or beneficial good supplies the object of attachment without assuming that the inventory specifies booty or money.

variant.image_en: what all incline toward as good
variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الخير العام المرغوب فيه، وضد الشر، وما فيه نفع أو فضل أو صلاح، والخير المطلق والمقيد، ومقابلته للشر أو الضر.
variant.scope_en: General good that is desired: the opposite of evil, what is beneficial, virtuous, sound, absolute or relative, and what is set against evil or harm.

citation.role: Intensity and exertion support the immediate description of the human's attachment.

variant.scope_ar: القوة والصلابة والشجاعة وثبات القلب وشدة الحال والجوع والعذاب والتشديد وبذل الجهد والقدرة
variant.scope_en: Strength, hardness, courage, firmness of heart, harsh condition, hunger, punishment, intensification, exertion, and capacity

citation.role: The distinct charging-and-running scope returns human intensity to the bodily action of the focus.

variant.scope_ar: الحمل على العدو في القتال والعدو والحضر
variant.scope_en: Charging against an enemy in battle, running, and swift movement

citation.role: The forceful bodily action is the source image.
The incursion setting makes the possible charge-and-overstepping association specific.
The human's conduct, rather than the animals' moral status, is the expressed subject of criticism.
The emphatic assertion of strong attachment supplies the psychological counterpart.
The scoped sound of horses' breathing while running supplies something internal becoming audible.

variant.scope_ar: صوت الثعلب والهام والبوم والذئب والصدى وصوت أنفاس الخيل وأفواهها في العدو
variant.scope_en: fox, owl, wolf, echo cry, and the audible breathing or mouth-sound of horses while running

citation.role: The witnessing-sign scope explicitly includes a horse's visible run as evidence of a state or quality, giving an unusually precise return to the focus scene.

variant.scope_ar: الشاهد لما يدل على وقت أو حال أو جودة مثل النجم وصلاة المغرب وشاهد جري الفرس
variant.scope_en: A visible sign that testifies to a time, state, or quality, such as the star, Maghrib prayer name, or a horse's visible run.

citation.role: Testifying from knowledge supplies the evidential function with which bodily manifestation is compared.

variant.scope_ar: الشهادة والخبر القاطع وأداء ما عند الشاهد والإعلام والبيان والإظهار والإقرار والحكم وما يقوم شاهدا أو شهيدا على غيره
variant.scope_en: Testimony, decisive report, stating or making known what one knows, declaration, acknowledgement, judgment, and any witness or proof-bearing role.

citation.role: The anatomical chest gives the later inner-content statement a bodily location comparable to the focus's breathing.

variant.scope_ar: صدر الإنسان والحيوان وما أشرف من أعلاه، ووجع الصدر وإصابته، وما يغطى الصدر أو يسمه أو يشد عليه، وما سمي لقوة صدره
variant.scope_en: Includes the anatomical chest, upper breast, chest pain or striking, chest-covering garments and marks or straps, and things named for a strong chest.

citation.role: Bringing a result into clarity, explicitly including disclosure of what is in chests, supplies the later revealing action.

variant.image_en: collecting a thing until its outcome is clear
variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه حصلت الشيء تحصيلا، والحاصل والمحصول بمعنى ما بقي وثبت بعد ذهاب غيره، ورد الكلام إلى محصوله، وإظهار ما في الصدور أو حاصل الحساب.
variant.scope_en: Includes collecting or resolving a thing, the resultant remainder after other parts pass away, reducing speech to its gist, and revealing what is in the breasts or the account-result.

citation.role: Knowledge of inward reality rather than outward appearance completes the comparison between perceptible signs and inner knowledge.

variant.image_en: knowledge by report and tested inner knowledge
variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الخبر والنبأ والإخبار والاستخبار والخبرة بمعنى الاختبار والمعرفة ببواطن الأمر والخبير العالم والمخبر الباطن لا المنظر
variant.scope_en: report, informing, inquiry, tested knowledge, inner knowledge, the knowing one, and inward character rather than outward appearance

citation.role: The opening renders movement and breath outwardly perceptible.
Witness language introduces explicit attestation of the preceding human condition.
The construction singles out inner contents for disclosure.
The final emphasis places those persons under their Lord's intimate knowledge.
Running supplies the initial agency and movement.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الجري والحضر وعدو الفرس والعدو على الأقدام
variant.scope_en: Includes running, hastening, a horse's running, and people running on foot.

citation.role: The scope of moving dust or earth from a settled state furnishes the first material disturbance.

variant.image_en: stirring something up from its settled state
variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه أثار الغبار أو الأرض، وإثارة التراب، واستثارة الأرنب، وإزعاج البرك وإنهاضها، وبحث علم القرآن على صورة إثارة المكنون
variant.scope_en: Includes making dust or land rise, stirring earth, rousing game, driving ponds or pools into movement, and searching out hidden knowledge by an image of stirring.

citation.role: Raised dust keeps the comparison tied to the actual material effect of the opening sequence.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه النقع بمعنى الغبار، ولا سيما الغبار المرتفع أو المثار.
variant.scope_en: Dust, especially dust raised up or stirred, belongs here.

citation.role: Overturning earth and extracting buried contents intensify surface disturbance into exposure of what lies underneath.

branches.source_ayah_ar: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه قلب التراب عن الشيء المدفون وإثارة ما في القبور وإخراجه وكشف الشيء المستور
variant.scope_en: Includes overturning earth from something buried, stirring up and bringing out what is in graves, and uncovering or extracting a concealed thing.

citation.role: Graves as the resting places of the dead specify the later ground and its contents.

branches.source_ayah_ar: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ

variant.image_en: placing the dead in a grave
variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه القبر مدفن الميت ومقره، وقبر الميت أي دفنه وجعله في القبر، وأقبره أي جعل له قبرا أو أذن في قبره أو صيره ذا قبر، والمقبرة موضع القبور
variant.scope_en: The branch covers the grave as the dead person's resting place, burial, providing or permitting a grave, and cemetery/place of graves

citation.role: Active participles establish bodies acting through forceful movement.
An active feminine plural verb carries their agency into dust-raising.

citation.quote_ar: أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
citation.role: The question turns attention toward a future condition, with buried contents undergoing a passive upheaval.

structural_cues.source_ayah_ar: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ

citation.role: A second passive extends the later condition of being subjected to disclosure.
Running-breath renders effort audible, supplying the expenditure side of the proposed comparison.

variant.scope_ar: صوت الثعلب والهام والبوم والذئب والصدى وصوت أنفاس الخيل وأفواهها في العدو
variant.scope_en: fox, owl, wolf, echo cry, and the audible breathing or mouth-sound of horses while running

citation.role: Stirring earth connects the opening activity to an actual ground image before any agrarian analogy is introduced.

variant.image_en: stirring something up from its settled state
variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه أثار الغبار أو الأرض، وإثارة التراب، واستثارة الأرنب، وإزعاج البرك وإنهاضها، وبحث علم القرآن على صورة إثارة المكنون
variant.scope_en: Includes making dust or land rise, stirring earth, rousing game, driving ponds or pools into movement, and searching out hidden knowledge by an image of stirring.

citation.role: Nurture and ongoing improvement supply the received care against which return can be considered.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه رب الشيء إذا أصلحه وأتمه وقام عليه، ورب النعمة والصنيعة والضيعة والولد والصبي، والتربية حالا فحالا
variant.scope_en: Includes repairing, completing, administering, and nurturing a thing, favor, estate, child, or young person stage by stage.

citation.role: The ordinary human ingratitude branch remains the proposition being imaged.

variant.scope_ar: الكنود وكند وامرأة كنود في كفر النعمة والمواصلة والمودة وعد المصائب ونسيان النعم والأثرة ومنع الرفد
variant.scope_en: Ingratitude for favor, companionship, and affection, including counting misfortunes, forgetting blessings, self-serving behavior, and withholding support.

citation.role: Barren land that produces nothing supplies a concrete non-return image for that human ingratitude.

variant.scope_ar: الأرض الكنود التي لا تنبت شيئا
variant.scope_en: Land described as kanud because it produces nothing.

citation.role: The explicitly scoped extraction of a kernel from husks allows disclosure to be pictured as drawing out an inner yield; the separate ore-extraction part is not needed.

variant.image_ar: استخراج اللب أو النفيس من غلافه
variant.image_en: bringing out the inner value from its covering
variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه التحصيل بمعنى إخراج اللب من القشور، وإخراج الذهب أو الفضة من حجر المعدن أو ترابه، وتمييز ما يحصل.
variant.scope_en: Includes extracting the kernel or valuable substance from husks, ore-stone, or mineral earth, and distinguishing what has been obtained.

citation.role: Energetic movement and breath anchor the proposed question about expenditure.
The running sequence has already made disturbed ground a visible result.
Nurturing lordship and human non-return occur within one relation.
The ending specifies inner contents as what is drawn into disclosure, allowing the yield image to return to the human.
The running-horse scope gives a concrete possible source for the hoof sparks named in the later distant branch.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الجري والحضر وعدو الفرس والعدو على الأقدام
variant.scope_en: Includes running, hastening, a horse's running, and people running on foot.

citation.role: Audible running-breath preserves the focus on bodily expenditure.

variant.scope_ar: صوت الثعلب والهام والبوم والذئب والصدى وصوت أنفاس الخيل وأفواهها في العدو
variant.scope_en: fox, owl, wolf, echo cry, and the audible breathing or mouth-sound of horses while running

citation.role: Actual struck fire in the adjacent scene supplies the trigger for a later hoof-spark association.

variant.scope_ar: قدح النار والزند والحجر والحديدة التي تورى بها النار
variant.scope_en: Striking or kindling fire from a fire-stick, stone, or implement.

citation.role: The ordinary attachment sense remains the meaning of the later human claim.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الحب والمحبة ونقيض البغض، والتحبيب، والمحبوب، والاستحباب بمعنى الإيثار، والمودة المتبادلة.
variant.scope_en: This branch covers love, affection, making beloved, being beloved, preference, and mutual affection.

citation.role: The Arabic scope specifically includes faint sparks from stones or horses' hooves and fire of no use; this concrete overlap, rather than the branch's firefly image, returns attention to the opening run.

variant.image_ar: نار الحباحب شرر لا ينتفع به
variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه نار الحباحب، الشرر الضعيف من الحجارة أو حوافر الخيل، والذباب أو الطائر المضيء ليلا، والنار التي لا ينتفع بها.
variant.scope_en: This branch covers faint sparks, weak useless fire, and night-flying glow described as نار الحباحب.

citation.role: Desired beneficial good supplies the value term against which merely flashing, unusable fire can be compared.

variant.image_en: what all incline toward as good
variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الخير العام المرغوب فيه، وضد الشر، وما فيه نفع أو فضل أو صلاح، والخير المطلق والمقيد، ومقابلته للشر أو الضر.
variant.scope_en: General good that is desired: the opposite of evil, what is beneficial, virtuous, sound, absolute or relative, and what is set against evil or harm.

citation.role: The opening supplies movement and bodily effort.
Fire is linked to that opening action before the distant branch is activated.
Strong attachment and desired good give the later association a question of value, rather than leaving it a second fire description.
